braille.notes: Byte-identical between A and B; matches independent re-extraction exactly. The leading blank braille line has no print-side source (no heading/paragraph precedes it in the given textLines range) — not representable from print.blocks alone.

resolution: Both runs (A, B) came from the same model (Gemini Pro via Antigravity, 17 Sep 2026) and are not independent; agreement was treated as no evidence. braille.lines independently re-extracted from references/_text/braille-formats-2016.txt (the line-number field, digits + >=3 spaces, or the fixed left margin measured in ASCII spaces before any U+2800 cell, stripped by counting; U+2800->space; trailing spaces removed). Modeled as a 'list' block, every item wholly uncontracted (backtick) per 17.8.1 ('do not contract syllabified words'); expect MATCH on the three word lines themselves.
